name: josstay
description: JosStay — Your city, your stay. Client and server for the Jos hotel booking platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @josstay/client" "npm run dev -w @josstay/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @josstay/client && npm run build -w @josstay/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @josstay/client && npm run typecheck -w @josstay/server
